definitions.explanation: A punishment imposed by law for committing a crime, including fines, imprisonment, and other legal penalties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{刑罰|けいばつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{科|か}される。
{刑罰|けいばつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{抑止|よくし}→抑止：07985_yokushi⟧だ。
examples.english: The purpose of criminal punishment is the deterrence of crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薬物|やくぶつ}→薬物：14053_yakubutsu⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧{刑罰|けいばつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧。
examples.english: In this country, criminal punishments for drug offenses are extremely heavy.

notes:
A formal legal term composed of ⟦{刑|けい}→刑：02786_kei⟧ (punishment/penalty) and ⟦{罰|ばつ}→罰：10154_batsu⟧ (punishment). Used primarily in legal, political, and academic contexts when discussing the justice system.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刑罰|けいばつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{科|か}す: to impose a punishment
- {刑罰|けいばつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a punishment
- {刑罰|けいばつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{軽|かる}く→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lighten a punishment
- ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{刑罰|けいばつ}: severe punishment
- {刑罰|けいばつ}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: penal system

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{罰|ばつ}→罰：10154_batsu⟧: punishment — more general, used for any punishment including informal ones
- ⟦{刑|けい}→刑：02786_kei⟧: sentence, penalty — the specific court-imposed sentence (e.g., ⟦{懲役|ちょうえき}→懲役：11087_choueki⟧⟦{刑|けい}→刑：02786_kei⟧ "prison sentence")
- ⟦{処罰|しょばつ}→処罰：21006_shobatsu⟧: punishment, penalization — slightly broader, includes disciplinary actions
- ⟦{罰則|ばっそく}→罰則：27147_bassoku⟧: penal provisions — the rules defining punishments in law
